name: Tactile Systems Technology, Inc.
summary: Tactile Systems Technology, Inc., a medical technology company, develops and provides medical devices to treat underserved chronic diseases in the United States. It offers Flexitouch Plus system, a pneumatic compression device for the treatment of lymphedema, phlebolymphedema, lipedema, venous insufficiencies, and other types of edema and leg ulcers; Entre Plus System, a pneumatic compression device for the at-home treatment of lymphedema, chronic edema, venous insufficiency, and chronic wounds.
